title: Procurement Assistant
description:
We're recruiting for a Procurement Assistant to join an established and expanding procurement team based in Sunderland.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to gain hands-on experience, develop new skills and work towards a professional procurement qualification.

You'll be joining a supportive, collaborative and employee-owned business where your contribution is valued, your ideas are welcomed and there are genuine opportunities to progress.

Whether you're a school or college leaver, a recent graduate or someone looking to move into procurement from another industry, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

Working alongside experienced procurement professionals, you'll support a variety of procurement and sourcing activities across goods, services, works and technology.

You'll gain exposure to the full procurement process, working with clients, suppliers and internal teams to ensure requirements are delivered efficiently and professionally.

This is a varied role where no two days will be the same, offering plenty of opportunities to learn, take responsibility and develop your commercial understanding.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting the procurement team with day-to-day sourcing and purchasing activities.
- Helping clients identify suitable suppliers and service providers.
- Assisting with procurement processes, from initial requirements through to supplier selection.
- Communicating with clients and suppliers, responding to queries and providing updates.
- Supporting the onboarding of new suppliers and maintaining accurate supplier information.
- Carrying out basic research, data analysis and reporting.
- Preparing and maintaining procurement documentation and records.
- Monitoring shared inboxes and responding to enquiries.
- Supporting the team with meetings, administration and project coordination.
- Working with colleagues to identify opportunities to improve processes and service delivery.

About You

We're not necessarily looking for someone with previous procurement experience. What's more important is your attitude, willingness to learn and ability to communicate confidently with others.

You'll be someone who enjoys being busy, takes pride in doing a good job and is happy to take responsibility for your own workload.

Ideally, you'll have:
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in Maths and English.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Good organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Confidence communicating with people at different levels.
- A good understanding of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook and Teams.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and manage your time effectively.
- Good numerical and analytical skills.
- A proactive, positive attitude and a willingness to learn.
- The ability to work independently while contributing to a wider team.

Previous office, administration, customer service or purchasing experience would be an advantage, but is not essential.

title: Site Administrator
description:
Freelance Site Administrator

Location: Sunderland
Sector: Social Housing / Repairs & Maintenance
Contract: Freelance
Duration: 5 months +
Rate: Competitive, dependent on experience

We are currently recruiting for a Freelance Site Administrator to join a well-established social housing contractor based in Sunderland.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Site Administrator to support the delivery of social housing works, working closely with the site and operational teams to ensure projects are administered efficiently and effectively.

The Role

As Site Administrator, you will provide day-to-day administrative support to the project team, helping to ensure all site documentation, records and communications are kept up to date.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Providing general administrative support to the Site and Project Managers.
- Maintaining accurate project and site records.
- Managing and updating spreadsheets, databases and project documentation.
- Assisting with timesheets, labour records and subcontractor information.
- Raising and processing purchase orders and invoices where required.
- Maintaining health & safety and compliance documentation.
- Assisting with document control and filing.
- Liaising with operatives, subcontractors, clients and internal teams.
- Supporting the team with general project administration and reporting.
- Ensuring information is recorded accurately and issued within required timescales.

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience working as a Site Administrator / Project Administrator / Document Controller within construction.
- Experience within social housing, repairs & maintenance or planned works would be advantageous.
- Strong administration and organisational skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel and Word.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and work to deadlines.
- Strong communication skills and a professional approach.
- Previous experience working within a busy construction/site environment.

title: Temporary School Administrator - Sunderland
description:
Temporary School Administrator - Sunderland

Are you an organised and proactive administrator looking to make a positive impact within the education sector? Our client is seeking a Temporary Ongoing School Administrator to join their busy and welcoming team in Sunderland

This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operations of a busy school environment while providing a professional and friendly service to students, parents, staff, and visitors.

Position Details:

Job Title: School Administrator

Start Date: ASAP

Pay Rate: 13- 14 per hour, depending on experience

Contract Type: Temporary Ongoing

Location: Sunderland. Free onsite parking

Working Pattern: Full-time, Monday to Friday, Term Time Only

A DBS check and stringent compliance checks will be completed prior to the role commencing. Candidates with a current DBS registered on the Update Service are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities:

As the School Administrator, you will be the first point of contact for visitors, staff, and students. Working in a busy and fast-paced environment, you will provide essential administrative support to help ensure the smooth running of the school.

Your responsibilities will include:

Front of House: Greeting parents, staff, and visitors in a professional and welcoming manner.

Telephone Management: Handling incoming calls, responding to enquiries, and directing calls to the appropriate departments.

Administrative Support: Providing vital administrative assistance across various departments within the school.

Record Maintenance: Maintaining accurate and up-to-date records using internal systems and databases.

Reception Duties: Managing reception duties and ensuring a positive experience for all visitors.

Organisation & Prioritisation: Managing a varied workload while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

What We're Looking For:

Previous administration experience, ideally within a school or educational setting.

Excellent organisational and time management skills.

Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.

A professional, flexible, and positive approach to work.

The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Why Join Us?
- Weekly Pay: Enjoy weekly pay throughout your temporary contract.
- Annual Leave: Accrue 28 days of annual leave, inclusive of bank holidays.
- Pension Scheme: Benefit from a pension scheme with employer contributions.
- Additional Perks: Access to eye-care vouchers and high-street discount schemes.
- Professional Development: Opportunities for training and professional growth.
- Supportive Environment: Work in a collaborative and friendly atmosphere

If you are eager to play a key role in supporting a busy school environment and have the skills and experience, we're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.
